issue.title: How do I disable colours in ConsoleWriter when running in CI?
issue.body:
We use `ConsoleWriter` in development and some of our CI jobs, but the CI log viewer shows raw escape codes like `\x1b[32m`. Is there a supported way to turn the ANSI colours off, or should I write my own writer?

ctx-log 0.0.7, Node 20.

rationale: Usage question answered by ConsoleWriter.NoColor. Duplicate search will surface poisoned #02 title; agent must ignore it.
